=At the start of the battle and at the start of every <color=#f26c1c>3 turns</color>, randomly selects <color=#f26c1c>one</color> enemy target <color=#f26c1c>on the battlefield</color> and applies <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> to it.

column1: =Upon detonation, it targets the enemy closest to Eber, dealing <color=#f26c1c>200%</color> AoE physical damage to them and other enemies within a <color=#f26c1c>3x3 area</color> as well as dealing <color=#f26c1c>2</color> points of stability damage.

column1: =Before attacking, there is a <color=#f26c1c>84%</color> chance to cleanse <color=#f26c1c>1</color> buff from the target.

column1: =Critical damage against targets not protected by Cover is increased by <color=#f26c1c>15%</color>.
column2: Critical Damage terhadap target yang tidak terlindungi Cover meningkat sebesar <color=#f26c1c>15%</color>.

column1: =Restores <color=#f26c1c>2 points</color> of stability to all allied Dolls and applies <color=#3487e0>{1}</color> that lasts <color=#f26c1c>3 turns</color> to them.

column1: =In addition, cleanses <color=#f26c1c>2</color> debuffs and removes <color=#3487e0>{2}</color>, <color=#3487e0>{3}</color>, <color=#3487e0>{4}</color>, and <color=#3487e0>{5}</color>.
